Import a DEPERIS round returned by Ramulus

Source: R/deperis.R
importer_deperis.Rd

Reads the package(s) .zip returned by the Ramulus app (a completed deperis.gpkg plus its photos/), checks them against the deperis-v1 format and the round that Nemeton wrote (creer_tournee_deperis()), and returns the verdict, the reasons and, unless refused, the data.

Usage

importer_deperis(
  zip,
  depart,
  precedent = NULL,
  operateur = NULL,
  version_ramulus = NULL,
  dossier_photos = NULL
)

Arguments

zip

Character. One or several .zip packages returned by Ramulus (or deperis.gpkg files).

depart

Character. Path of the deperis.gpkg that creer_tournee_deperis() wrote for this round (what Nemeton wrote must come back unchanged).

precedent

Optional result of an earlier importer_deperis() of the same round; its data are merged with zip (replay without duplicates).

operateur, version_ramulus

Operator and Ramulus version written in the tournee row of the union when several packages are merged (default: those of the first package).

dossier_photos

Optional directory where the photos kept by the import are copied (never written on refusal).

Value

A list of class deperis_import with verdict ("accepte", "signale" or "refuse"), motifs (sorted reason codes), messages, importe (logical), nature, code_tournee, and, when imported: placettes, centres (sf points, EPSG:2154), notes (data.frame with the recomputed classe and the source table), photos (data.frame nom, sha256, chemin), conflits (data.frame objet, cle, plot_id, message) and placettes_signalees (plots whose centre was left out for a conflict, kept with their notes). The paquet element keeps the merged package for precedent.

Details

The import is all or nothing: a package with at least one refusal reason imports nothing. It is replayable without duplicates: rows are merged on their uuid, so importing the same package twice, or a package already contained in precedent, gives the same data. Several packages (several operators) are merged the same way; a same uuid (or photo) with two different contents is a conflict: both versions are left out, the rest of the union is kept and the package is flagged (uuid_contenu_different), never settled silently. The class of each note is recomputed from the abacus (MB and MR or MA) of the DSF sheets and a different class is refused (classe_differente_abaque).

The reasons come from the catalogue of the format (copy of the Ramulus schema in inst/schemas/): refusals such as plan_modifie (a value Nemeton wrote came back changed), essence_hors_referentiel, note_hors_bornes, photo_absente, hors_france, and flags such as doublon_arbre, centre_eloigne, uuid_contenu_different. A flagged package is imported with its flags; only a refusal blocks.

See also

creer_tournee_deperis()
